description.value: Olivo Cafe is a Metro Vancouver multi-location cafe concept specializing in authentic Mexican tacos and fusion brunch, operating under the combined brand 'Olivo Cafe + Tacosaurus Food Truck.' The Tacosaurus food truck arm handles catering and private events across the region. Confirmed locations are in Burnaby and Surrey, with a North Vancouver location described as coming soon.
